entries.en: (Error)
Heheh! Don't you want to save your poor[n]teammate?
Why don't we make a deal? Hand over[n]that [f 2 5 3 9999 3].
Heehee! If you value your teammate's[n]life, you'd better do as I say, dearie.
Why don't we make it [var 0] yen...[n]A paltry price to pay, no?
Do you want to do something for your[n]teammate? Then let me squeeze some[n]health out of you.
If you want to save your teammate, let me[n]drain your youthful stamina, dearie...[n]Heehee!
Fine, you win.
I can't meet your demands.
Call Thieves Guild ([var 5] left).
[clr 2]You're up, Panther.[clr 27]
...If I let you off the hook this easily,[n]people might think I'm too lenient,[n]dearie.
This time, I think you'd better hand over[n]that [f 2 5 3 9999 3]. You do want to[n]save your precious teammate, right?
...This is the bare minimum! The least you[n]could do is add a tip for me.
Come now, give me [var 0] yen.[n]Don't be so stingy, child.
Somehow, I don't feel very satisfied...[n]Was your gift really from the heart?
Allow me to squeeze some health out of[n]you next. Come now, it won't hurt a bit.
...You still seem rather well-composed.
This time, I'm going to take your stamina.[n]It's for your teammate, so just be a big[n]boy, okay?
...That should be enough. There, there,[n]I'll let you have your teammate back,[n]dearie.
...I think I've picked on you long enough.[n]Here, I'll return your teammate, dearie.
Goodness, you don't care about your[n]teammate? Suit yourself, child. I won't[n]show any mercy!
I see... Your teammate just gets in the way,[n]hm? Well then, I'll dispose of them for you,[n]dearie!
...I'm not one to go along with the crowd,[n]but abandoning your teammate is[n]definitely a no-no.
You make me ill. I'm going to take my[n]leave from this mess...
Are your teammates that disposable to[n]you...? Goodness, humans are awfully[n]frightening...
I don't want to deal with you anymore.
If you want me to keep you company,[n]try to be a little more manly next time,[n]dearie...
Ah, I'm exhausted. I'll be taking my[n]leave...
Well then, let's get back to business.[n]I won't lose this time!
...Now, why don't we get back to business?
What in the world!? What a cheeky child!
What's this!? Do you have more allies[n]around!?
What are you crying for!? Oh fine, I'll let[n]you off the hook for one [f 2 5 3 9999 3].
What? Are you even younger than I[n]thought? Fine, I'll let this go for about[n][var 0] yen.
Why are you crying, dearie!? Goodness...[n]I'll let you go if you give me some health.
What? Act your age, will you? Fine,[n]dearie—I'll let this go if you give me some[n]of your stamina.
Now I feel bad, like I've made my dear[n]grandchild cry... Fine, do whatever you[n]want then.
Good heavens, I apologize... I'll leave, so[n]please stop crying!
...Don't be a showoff, you little brat! You[n]don't even have any!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: No... How could you take that from us!?
Another band of thieves[n]responded to the call!
